Naina Pandey
Senior DevOps Engineer | Hyderabad, Telangana
naina.pandey466@example.com | +91 9173007816

Seasoned DevOps engineer focused on building resilient, automated cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines. Experienced in designing and operating Kubernetes-based platforms, automated CI/CD systems, and infrastructure-as-code workflows to improve reliability and release velocity. Seeking to continue scaling platform operations and developer productivity.

Experience

Ledgerly — Apr 2021 - Present
Senior DevOps Engineer (Remote)
- Designed and operated Kubernetes clusters for multi-tenant services, reducing deployment incidents by 40% while maintaining 99.95% service availability; implemented automated pod autoscaling and resource quotas using Kubernetes.
- Containerized legacy services with Docker and introduced standardized images and vulnerability scanning, cutting mean time-to-recover by 30% and decreasing image size by 25%.
- Implemented infrastructure-as-code and environment provisioning with Terraform to create reproducible staging and production environments, reducing environment spin-up time from days to under 2 hours.
- Built CI/CD pipelines integrating CICD practices and GitHub Actions to enable daily releases; automated rollbacks and canary deployments to minimize production impact.

Trellis Systems — Jan 2021 - Mar 2021
DevOps Engineer (Contract)
- Migrated core microservices to Kubernetes clusters on AWS, improving deployment consistency and reducing cross-environment bugs by 35%.
- Automated build and deployment workflows with CICD best practices and Jenkins pipelines, shortening release cycles from weekly to bi-weekly.
- Implemented centralized logging and monitoring using CloudWatch metrics and alerts to detect and remediate performance regressions within 15 minutes on average.
- Managed Docker image lifecycle and implemented Git branching strategies with Git to streamline developer collaboration.

Kite Learning — Nov 2017 - Dec 2020
Cloud Engineer (On-site)
- Architected and maintained AWS-hosted infrastructure using Terraform and Lambda-based serverless components to handle asynchronous workloads with SQS queues, achieving 99.9% uptime for learner-facing APIs.
- Built CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Jenkins to automate testing, builds, and deployments across QA and production, cutting manual release steps by 70%.
- Hardened Linux-based application hosts and optimized container deployments on Kubernetes, improving application start-up time by 20% and reducing infrastructure costs through rightsizing.
- Instrumented applications and infrastructure with CloudWatch dashboards and alerts, enabling SLO-driven incident response and reducing average incident duration by 45%.

Projects
- Automated Canary Deployment Framework: Developed a reusable set of GitHub Actions and Kubernetes manifests to perform automated canary rollouts and health checks; used by multiple teams to safely release features.
- Serverless Notification Processor: Implemented an AWS Lambda + SQS pipeline to process user event notifications, improving throughput to 5x and reducing cold-start impact via provisioned concurrency.

Skills
Languages: Python, Bash
Platform & Orchestration: Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform
CI/CD & Dev Tools: CICD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Git
Cloud & Services: AWS (Lambda, CloudWatch, SQS), Linux

Education
M.Tech, Data Science, IIIT Hyderabad

Notice period: 90 days
